name: Mithral Armor

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: No Strength requirement and no Disadvantage on Stealth checks.
text: Mithral is a light, flexible metal. If the armor normally imposes Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.
